A '''DH-Omni Support Vessel''' was in service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|navy]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic]]. The [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|supply ship]] crashed on the [[planet]] [[Agamar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] during a [[Battle of Agamar (Clone Wars)|battle]] between Republic and Separatist forces. Following the war's [[Mission to Mustafar|conclusion]] and the deactivation of the [[Separatist Droid Army]] in [[19 BBY]], the vessel was left derelict on the planet's surface, and was used to house the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[General]] [[Kalani]] and his [[Agamar garrison|garrison]] of [[battle droid]]s, which remained there [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|until]] [[2 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Armed with no weapons, this [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel]] was equipped with an external loudspeaker and an internal [[ray shield]] generator. It also had at least one large [[hangar]] bay that carried at least three [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]].<ref name="The Last Battle" />

==History==
After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Confederacy military|forces]] were defeated during the [[Onderonian Civil War|civil war]] on the [[planet]] [[Onderon]], the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[General]] [[Kalani]] was ordered by Confederate [[Head of State]] [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to withdraw what forces remained and await further orders above<ref name="Tipping Points">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> planet [[Agamar]].<ref name="Tipping Points" /> However, the [[supply ship]], carrying Kalani and his forces, was [[Battle of Agamar (Clone Wars)|engaged]] by [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Republic Military|forces]] and crashed on the planet's surface during the battle,<ref name="Build Your Own R2-D2 51" /> and remained abandoned as the [[Clone Wars]] moved toward its [[Mission to Mustafar|conclusion]] in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' states that the events of "[[The Last Battle]]" occur seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of "The Last Battle" must take place in [[2 BBY]].</ref> While on Agamar, Kalani later received the order to deactivate himself and his [[droid]] forces, but assumed it to be a Republic trick and refused to follow his orders.<ref name="The Last Battle" /> As a result, for seventeen [[Standard year|years]],<ref name="Date" /> Kalani and his [[Agamar garrison|garrison]]<ref name="USNWE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> of battle droids waited for the chance to end the Clone Wars in favor of the Separatist Alliance.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

[[File:The_Last_Battle_thumb.png|thumb|left|250px|Operating under [[Battle Plan Zeta]], B1 battle droids march out of the supply ship's hangar.]]
Later during the [[Galactic Civil War]] in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the supply ship was [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|visited]] by several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] operatives of [[Phoenix Cell]] who traveled to the planet in search of [[proton bomb]]s for their fight against the [[Galactic Empire]], but were instead forced by Kalani to take part in his battle otherwise they would be [[Death|terminated]]. During the battle, however, the Empire, alerted by a [[distress signal]] sent out by the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P]], dispatched an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] and two [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruisers]] carrying [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]s and [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|All Terrain Armored Transports]] to the [[Agamar system]] to destroy the rebels, which resulted in both the [[garrison]] and [[Spectres|rebels]] joining forces to fight off the Imperial forces and make their escape from the planet in three ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles, [[Phantom II|one]] of which was kept by the rebels as their replacement<ref name="The Last Battle" /> for the [[Mission to Reklam Station|destroyed]] ''[[Phantom]]''<ref name="Steps Into Shadow">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref> and another which was destroyed amid the escape.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
This DH-Omni Support Vessel first appeared in "[[The Last Battle]],"<ref name="The Last Battle" /> the sixth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]], which aired on [[October 22]], [[2016]].<ref name="Zap2it The Last Battle">{{WebCite|url=http://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-the-last-battle/EP018796240061?aid=zap2it|text=Star Wars Rebels : ''The Last Battle''|work=[http://tvlistings.zap2it.com Screener]|archivedate=20170704001134}}</ref>
